upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluation is pinned to this exact successor head. Later Harbor main commits do not inherit qualification automatically.

materialChanges: Preserves native task names and validates replacement locks through Harbor's native task-ID API instead of silently changing task identity.

Reviews recorded-run inference access from immutable run configuration and the current image while preserving explicit review and existing owned policy scope; review is not an automatic grant or execution event.

Normalizes JSON number transport before native replacement-evidence validation so integral-float union values can retain the intended existing fingerprint without introducing a fallback hash or rewriting stored source evidence.
Pauses a run on any unacknowledged owned Hugging Face parent error instead of automatically launching another parent, requiring explicit operator resume.
Records explicit acknowledgements as owned parent-error job IDs; new errors require new review and acknowledgement is not provider status, native retry state or success evidence.

acceptance: Pin exact Harbor source 59756acf33bcdf4c63ab9a5cf30b9bcc7d0caa30 and keep dafc6a3c0a98f806d23f26cd5438ceb8367390ec as the rollback predecessor.

Cross-language numeric fixtures must prove intended integral-float normalization while preserving booleans, fractional floats and arbitrary integers; non-finite values and unsafe integer precision changes fail closed.
Do not add a fallback hash, dual identity, evidence migration or source rewrite to make mismatched replacement evidence pass.
Native task names and task IDs must round-trip through replacement selection and coverage checks without widening or silently relabeling the selected cohort.

Current-image inference-access review must derive only from immutable recorded run configuration and existing owned scope; missing, stale or conflicting review evidence grants nothing and starts no work.
Any unacknowledged owned parent error must persist a pause and must not launch another parent. Repeated reconciliation of the same error is idempotent.
Explicit resume may acknowledge only currently observed owned parent-error IDs under the existing run lock; unknown recorded-parent state, source drift or review failure cannot acknowledge or launch.
A newly observed parent error after resume requires a new review. Acknowledgement is operator decision metadata, never native retry state, provider status or a success receipt.

Preserve native Harbor trial retries, immutable original evidence, replacement lineage, native aggregation, anti-double-counting, selected-versus-all-incurred cost accounting, private Dataset/LFS/provider-secret isolation and cancellation semantics from the predecessor wave.
Exercise rollback to the exact reviewed-replacement predecessor contract without mutating original executions, receipts or source evidence.

Keep results EVALUATION unless independent normal controls prove more; no paid Job, provider write, Hub publication, product route/default change, model qualification or automatic promotion is authorized.

They do not turn reviewed replacement runs into independent benchmark observations, do not certify provider recovery, do not authorize paid execution and do not qualify a model or production route.
